message_en:
🚀 Bhu Meter 1.2.5 – Diwali Mega Update!

📝 NEW Custom Report Studio: Create professional reports and export PDF, BhuMap, DXF & images.
📐 Smart Auto Scale for DWG & BhuMap.
🎨 Advanced Map Customization & Magic Edit to remove unwanted boundary points.
📏 Custom Units, Sub-units & Unit Calculator.
📍 Live Location & Accuracy Circle in Satellite Map Measure.
🗺️ Two-Finger Overlay Rotation.
📂 Open maps from WhatsApp & File Manager.
✨ Premium improvements & bug fixes!
